messages:
anna (partnerships): Quick heads-up — we have a kickoff with CloudBridge (SI) + VaultSphere (secrets manager) next week. They want a joint marketplace listing and co-announcement. The integrations scope: SSO/SAML, SCIM user sync, and KMS/HSM-backed key wrap. Need owners and a rough timeline. Who can own technical coord?
raj (eng): I can take technical lead on the SCIM + SSO cert exchange details. Need to confirm VaultSphere supports OIDC metadata and SCIM bulk operations.
matt (security): Thanks. For KMS/HSM, we need to validate attestation and key wrap semantics (RFC 7516-ish). Also pen-test window — can we get a pre-GA security review?
julia (product): From product side I'll own the marketplace listing content and PR cadence. Marcos, can marketing prep partner co-branding guidelines and embargo dates?
marcos (marketing): Yep. Need partner logo SVGs and their legal pre-approval for quotes. Suggest holding co-announcement 2 weeks after joint integration QA. Will draft timeline. :calendar: 
sophie (legal): For quotes and marketplace terms, we need a partner MOU. Also confirm data residency clauses for SCIM exports. I can start an MOU template and loop in their contracts team.
anna (partnerships): Great. Quick ask: can we map a simple timeline in the thread? Proposed: Week 0 kickoff, Week 1 API spec + cert exchange, Week 2 integration QA, Week 3 e2e testing + pen-test, Week 4 marketplace listing + embargo, Week 5 co-announcement. Thoughts?
raj (eng): That looks doable. Need a gating checklist item for KMS key rotation compatibility and HSM firmware compliance. I'll add those to the tech checklist.
matt (security): Add SOC2 evidence request and any KMS audit log schema we require. Also require a threat model review before public announcement.
marcos (marketing): Putting tentative embargo = 2025-07-10 (subject to QA). Will prepare announcement copy drafts by Week 3.
sophie (legal): MOU draft ETA EOD Wed. Also will request partner's DPA addendum for SCIM user attributes.
anna (partnerships): OK owners so far: Tech = raj, Security = matt, Product = julia, Marketing = marcos, Legal = sophie. I'll schedule the kickoff: Tue 09:30 PT. Devops-bot: calendar invite to be sent.
devops-bot: invite sent to attendees for Tue 09:30 PT — Zoom link included.
julia (product): For marketplace metadata, we need these fields from VaultSphere: supported auth flows, regions, billing model, and screenshots. @VaultSphere contact — please prepare.
raj (eng): Small config note for engineers: SCIM endpoints should support pagination & incremental sync (If-Modified-Since). Example check:
```
GET /scim/v2/Users?startIndex=1&count=100
If-Modified-Since: 2025-06-01T00:00:00Z
```
matt (security): Also agree on token rotation policy and service-account scope. We should avoid long-lived admin tokens for SCIM provisioning.
anna (partnerships): Thanks everyone — I'll post the kickoff agenda and owners matrix after the call. If anyone has blockers before Tue ping me in thread. :thumbsup:
